descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you a proven investment banking professional with deep Financial Institutions Group (FIG) expertise? We’re looking for somebody to join our FIG Coverage team to drive client engagement, strategic advisory, and origination across a portfolio of financial institution clients. In this role, you will:
• -develop and manage senior client relationships across banks, insurers, asset managers, and specialty finance companies
• -originate and execute a broad range of transactions, including M&A, equity and debt capital raising, and other strategic advisory engagements
• -partner with product teams (ECM, DCM, Leveraged Finance, M&A) to deliver integrated solutions to clients
• -lead client dialogue, including idea generation, pitching, and execution oversight
• -support sector coverage strategy, including identifying growth opportunities and market themes
• -manage transaction processes end-to-end, coordinating internal teams and external advisors
• -mentor and develop junior bankers, fostering a high-performance team environment
